name: Rie Miseki (みせき りえ)
reason: Health rule (strict): her own site (healingirie.com, Healing IRIE, Ishigaki, Okinawa; email published on its shop-information page) sells every Quantum-Touch item through conditions: the session page lists pain relief, pelvis and bone realignment, swelling, inflammation and injury recovery, menstrual problems and a scoliosis before-and-after; the Level 1 workshop page promises pain reduction, inflammation relief and bone correction; the energy-healing class promises better immunity. The rest of the site is aromatherapy certification courses (including a dementia-prevention head treatment course) and a clairvoyant-reading bracelet. Nothing passes the strict rule beyond a bare item name.
